Remove an entry when the review returns; an empty list is the normal state. `unchanged_since` is the commit the declaration pins: no commit after it may touch the path. HEAD itself is NEVER pinned -- committing the review prompt moves HEAD, so a HEAD pin is stale the moment it is written (measured 2026-08-25: a Sol session STOPped on exactly that). Nothing on ops/OUTCOME_CARRYING_ARTIFACTS.json may be listed here. Each entry declares role: "delivery" (a document authored for this review; must itself carry the off-limits list) or "reference" (pre-existing bytes handed along; scanned for unmarked quarantined paths, but NOT required to carry governance text — requiring that would mean editing an approved record to satisfy a test). Guarded by tests/test_artifacts_under_review_are_frozen.py and tests/test_review_artifacts_are_outcome_clean.py
